title: Global Orchestrator Watcher
summary: Decision dossier for a global intelligent exception layer above the mechanical delivery invariants. The central event bus is the shared substrate: the Watcher consumes typed escalation, integration, delivery, starvation, stale, loop, and contradiction signals, then publishes findings, recipe receipts, analyses, and decision needs into the same All-Activity-default stream. Three theme-aware mockups show interleaved Activity entries, persistent Studio-shell presence, and an AGT-2531 NoTaskBranch finding detail. The observe-first recommendation and approval-gated fence policy remain unchanged.
